name: Enhance Form (body)
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist 2, bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, magus 2, paladin 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, summoner 2

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)
Target Restrictions Personal, Selected

DESCRIPTION

The target of a wordspell with this effect word receives a +4 enhancement bonus to either Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution (caster’s choice). The target can end a wordspell with this effect word prematurely as a swift action, gaining a +8 enhancement bonus to the ability score until the end of the target’s turn.
